sourceDocuments.purpose: Authoritative list of twelve held prerequisites
Synthetic journey acceptance and batch separation
Operator usability evidence; no owner acceptance
Invented non-provider signature and replay tests
Mock rate, spending, stop and monitoring tests

prerequisites.requiredArtifact: Server identity, independent MFA, recovery and revocation acceptance record
Tenant-scoped API authorization, GRANT and RLS review, cross-brand IDOR test evidence
Reviewed notice, purpose inventory, collection minimization and storage replacement decision
Channel and purpose consent proof, withdrawal and STOP/HELP suppression acceptance
Approved retention schedule, access/correction, secure deletion and backup response evidence
Selected provider contract, authenticated webhook, replay and invalid-event tests
Protected keys, rotation, secret redaction, access-revocation and incident drills
Real provider and backend rate/cost controls, emergency stop and spam/fraud negative tests
Private audited logs, alerting, evidence integrity and rollback/restore drill reports
Bell Fibe/cell number authorization, brand/personal isolation, routing and reversal plan
Unconflicted external staging security/privacy report, residual risk and release recommendation
Separate verified owner decision specifying exact pilot scope, costs, numbers, data, users and rollback
